The graph presents a comparison of the performance of four different configurations using a box-car predictor, as indicated by the y-axis labeled with numbers, which appear to represent accuracy or a similar metric. The x-axis is labeled with the symbol '831', which might represent a time sequence, iterations, or an index, formatted with a modulo operation rather than a traditional linear or logarithmic scale.

There are four lines on the graph, each representing one of the configurations. The blue solid line with triangle markers, labeled "Llama-3B," increases steadily throughout the x-axis, starting from an accuracy level near 6 and reaching close to 8 by the end. The green dashed line with triangle markers, labeled "Llama-3B + FT," starts just below 5 and closely follows the trend of "Llama-3B," ending slightly above its final value.

The dotted blue line labeled "Llama-1B" begins at an accuracy level that is about 2 less than the starting point of "Llama-3B," and it follows a path that is consistently below "Llama-3B" throughout its range. The light blue line with triangle markers, labeled "Llama-1B + FT," starts at a similar level as "Llama-1B" but ends with a slightly higher accuracy, surpassing "Llama-1B" but not reaching the accuracy of "Llama-3B + FT."

In summary, "Llama-3B" shows the highest accuracy across the x-axis, followed by "Llama-3B + FT" which closely replicates "Llama-3B." "Llama-1B" consistently underperforms compared to its combined version with FT and "Llama-3B."
